summary.prose: Introduce one fixed, opt-in slow-VM timing policy and carry it through runtime I/O, owned build processes and native qualification without changing ordinary defaults. Child launch uses the parent’s remaining time and reserved cleanup, while outer deadlines cancel in-process preparation and containing runners reserve enough time. Validate each implementation task with surrounding tests, then qualify a fresh UTM home after prior-worker closure and run a final current-source scoped regression with an independent closure audit.

tasks.title: Add and publish the fixed qualification budget policy
tasks.summary: Add proposed src/installer/qualification-time-budgets.mjs and src/installer/qualification-time-budgets.d.mts. Select normal/slow-vm once at import, deeply freeze role values, validate the enum before admission, and preserve every normal numeric value. Update copy-assets.mjs to copy and byte-verify the MJS beside compiled consumers; exercise installed and bundled imports through existing payload publication. No application/source-builder dependencies in the policy.
acceptanceChecks: Absent/normal and slow-vm snapshots match the LLD role table exactly; slow-vm includes 40min commands,4h worker/manager,2h qualification build/file,5h qualification run,120s manager cleanup and5min outer cleanup.
Unknown/empty/whitespace/numeric selectors fail with qualification-profile-invalid before work; policy cannot change after import or mutation.

Copied out policy matches source bytes and imports independently; repeat actual installed/bundled consumer integration in t5 once all consumers are wired. Preserve runtime identity/wire/payload provenance rules.

tasks.title: Propagate the profile through coordinator and Git scopes
tasks.summary: Update scripts/test-harness/context.mjs and existing child environment composition in scripts/test-harness/process.mjs as required by actual call paths. Use fixed coordinator defaults and canonical profile in every owned child/custom/private-npm environment; supply omission, reject conflict and Windows case aliases. Preserve exact validated explicit overrides and lease/run schemas. Select Git role in src/installer/dev-git.ts. Use existing coordinator fixtures, with proposed focused policy tests as needed.
acceptanceChecks: Existing normal DEFAULT_BUDGETS and Git values remain exact; slow role values reach run.json and actual retained child environments.
Deliberately short explicit clocks remain exact after selection; invalid overrides still reject.
Omitted selectors are restored from admitted snapshot and conflicting/invalid selectors reject before spawn, including duplicate Windows key casing; private npm aliases retain the profile.
Existing lease ownership, unique admission/close/disposal journals and strict closure behavior are preserved.

tasks.title: Apply selected budgets to runtime acquisition and resource closure
tasks.summary: Update timing fields only in src/installer/runtime-metadata.ts and existing src/installer/runtime-acquire.ts, src/installer/runtime-store.ts, src/installer/controller-store.ts, src/installer/bootstrap-foundation.ts, src/installer/runtime-archive.ts and src/installer/download.ts consumers. Cover deadline wrappers, ZIP decoder drains and enclosing resource guards. Keep src/installer/owned-file.ts successful-close semantics; it has no standalone close timer. Audit actual related callers for hidden normal caps without redesigning resource ownership.
acceptanceChecks: slow-vm acquisition/download/extraction40min, read-only verification/publication8min and existing resource/decoder drains30s reach actual helper timers; normal600s/120s/5s remain.
downloadBoundedAsset retains its owner's signal; no redundant shorter hidden acquisition cap or invented synchronous-close timeout.
RUNTIME_LIMITS shape, structural byte/count caps, independent integrity pins, headers/npm binding, durable writes and actual resource closure remain unchanged.
Accelerated cancellation/uncertainty tests confirm expiry never authorizes stage removal or successful publication.

tasks.title: Bound worker launch by remaining parent time and cleanup reserve
tasks.summary: Update src/installer/dev-delivery.ts ownedScope and src/installer/dev-worker.ts to use manager/worker roles and canonical inherited profile. Capture monotonic parent expiry at admission and pass the LLD local-only deadline option. Immediately after runtime verification, before scope.start, cap selected/explicit worker allowance by parent remaining minus reserve; fail before spawn when exhausted. Preserve existing cancel frames, DevWorkerLaunch JSON and finalization proof. Verify private toolchain env in src/installer/dev-toolchain.ts without unrelated refactoring. Explicitly include scripts/test-harness/process.mjs in this task: capture one monotonic soft/hard cleanup deadline at the first drain of each retained scope and reuse only its remaining allowance across nested/repeated/final drains. Independently reobserve actual closure on every call; never cache a successful proof or alter ownership/disposal/journal/lease semantics. Extend the existing parent reserve fixture for repeated-drain exhaustion and run surrounding scripts/__tests__/test-harness.test.ts and scripts/__tests__/test-harness-coordinator.test.ts checks.
acceptanceChecks: Barrier-controlled runtime setup consumes parent allowance; child clock is computed after setup and never resets parent time.
No positive remaining allowance yields source-build-failed before spawn; short explicit budgetMs remains a cap.
Worker/manager use selected role values and manager120s reserve contains worker30s drain/final evidence; early cancellation remains immediate.
Actual result, worker lease closure and parent command disposal remain required; wire/controller/receipt schemas unchanged; missing proof stays preparation-uncertain.

Each retained processScope has one cumulative cleanupMs ceiling across nested launch/build and final owner drains, under both profiles. Repeated uncertain drains cannot schedule a new allowance; every call independently checks current actual closure and errors. Numeric normal defaults, cooperative cancellation, ownership/disposal journals and uncertainty/lease retention remain unchanged; surrounding coordinator/process regressions pass.

tasks.title: Wire qualification cancellation, evidence and containing budgets
tasks.summary: Update scripts/qualify-runtime-foundation.mjs to select outer role before allocation, record profile/resolved role caps at evidence start and connect outer work expiry to its AbortController across independent/in-process preparation. Update runtime-foundation-only .github/workflows/ci.yml profile selection and containment240min normal/360min slow; retain backend20min behavior. Add proposed scripts/qualification-containment.mjs with focused proposed scripts/__tests__/qualification-containment.test.ts for shared finite admission checks, and document the local detached supervisor envelope in docs/testing.md. Bound setup/preflight and refuse native admission with insufficient remaining allowance. Do not dispatch Windows job.
acceptanceChecks: Invalid selector fails before fresh home/lease allocation; evidence records selected role values without certifying success.
Outer expiry and explicit cancellation reach independently owned worker/in-process packaging, with cascading bounded cleanup; timers/listeners dispose on all exits.
Hosted slow profile fits360min: preflight work<=40min plus setup/drain<=5min; native5h plus cascade<=7min; remaining diagnostic headroom. Admission refuses insufficient remaining time.

Normal runtime-foundation job contains existing2h native budget; backend workflow behavior is unchanged. Local supervisor covers selected5h work plus drain/diagnostics, with no hidden60/90/120min wrapper.
Use owned coordinator for preflight; selected-test run/file caps are reconciled with enclosing allowance; Windows ownership prerequisite remains separate, no native dispatch.
After t2-t4 wiring, prove actual installed/bundled consumers receive copied policy bytes and preserve import boundaries; avoid a generic supervisor framework.

tasks.title: Validate the slow profile on the UTM macOS guest
tasks.summary: After all implementation surrounding checks pass, use a committed built source in the existing ordinary-user UTM macOS guest. First establish qualified retired-worker closure/reconciliation through existing proof; retain iq-wZetTc stage, checkpoint and lease untouched while proof is absent. Once admitted, use a fresh home and retained detached supervisor under slow-vm for live official Node acquisition, offline reuse, private npm/build/payload/native consumers. Record exact source, OS/runtime, budget roles, stages and independent parent/worker closure in this story's evidence. Do not claim historical Linux or fixture Windows evidence as current native proof.
acceptanceChecks: Retired worker closure prerequisite is positively satisfied before a new qualification; PID/age/closed child commands alone do not suffice. If absent, record blocked with retained evidence and do not retry.
Fresh UTM run uses INSRC_QUALIFICATION_PROFILE=slow-vm and sufficient supervisor allowance, with Node22 and matching npm; CUDA skip is set only if absent.
Live acquisition, offline zero-network reuse, private build/payload/native consumer probes complete successfully with matching identity and full independent parent/worker closure.
No release enablement or host daemon/Ollama mutation; failed/missing native evidence remains unsatisfied. Feedback corrections go through affected task checks before completion.

Evidence explicitly distinguishes blocked admission, failed actual qualification and passing actual qualification; no native work overlaps canonical final regression. An unfulfilled prerequisite cannot mark t6 or story complete.

tasks.title: Complete current-source scoped regression and story validation
tasks.summary: After all implementation tasks and native feedback corrections, run one canonical Node22 regression over all installer tests plus installation-home/build/scanner/coordinator consumers using a fixed enumerated selection. Perform independent post-run exact coverage, source/input/output fingerprints and positive command/resource closure audit on the same output without rebuilding. Record per-task checks, native evidence limitations and source identity; submit story BUILD validation only after required tasks pass. No unrelated backend sweep or per-task human approval.
acceptanceChecks: Every required LLD test subject maps to recorded task evidence; canonical current-source selection has no failures/incomplete/unexpected omissions.
Independent audit proves exact selected coverage, unchanged pinned inputs/outputs, all owned command admission/close/disposal pairs, no remaining actors/leases and strict positive cleanup.
Old275-test pass and Linux native proof remain historical; source changes after final run invalidate current regression until affected checks and final audit are repeated as justified.
All required native and regression gates are satisfied before story completion/final human BUILD approval; foundation/S4 and Windows remain separate gated work.

one deeply frozen process-local QUALIFICATION_TIME_BUDGETS value selected once
Explicit overrides remain last and are never multiplied
After runtime verification, immediately before scope.start, cap the child allowance
Refuse before native admission if remaining hosted job allowance cannot contain the selected qualifier and cleanup
Run surrounding tests only per task; one final scoped regression after all source tasks
establish the retired attempt's worker closure/reconciliation through existing qualified ownership proof

One scope may be drained zero or more times by nested worker/build consumers and by withRun finally; every call independently checks current children, markers, positive disposal journals and evidence/cancellation errors, but cannot restart the wait allowance or cache successful proof.
